# Third-party Trees

This directory keeps reference copies of upstream or locally diverged config trees that informed this repo.

## Layout

- `upstream/ezsh`: subtree-managed upstream copy of `jotyGill/ezsh`
- `local-snapshots/wezterm-current`: historical snapshot of the local WezTerm checkout from this machine (removed from the working tree and archived at git tag `archive/wezterm-current-snapshot`)

These trees are not installed by the bootstrap scripts. They exist for auditability and future extraction work.
